content:
maria: Deploybot flagged the staging publish for release/6501 — automatic hold due to an authz mismatch on cross-account push. Anyone from infra around?

deploybot: publish-check FAIL for image registry://eu-west-1/123456789012/release/6501
Error: PutImageAuthorizationFailed: cross-account role lacks ecr:PutImage -> hold applied. See runbook: https://go/runbooks/ecr-mirror-authz

alex: I'll take a look. can you paste the exact error payload from the mirror job logs?

maria: copying the mirror logs below:
```
time="2026-03-21T09:12:03Z" level=error msg="PutImage failed" error="AccessDenied: User: arn:aws:sts::111222333444:assumed-role/mirror-runner/ecr-sync is not authorized to perform: ecr:PutImage on resource: arn:aws:ecr:eu-west-1:123456789012:repository/release/6501"
caused_by=\"PutImageAuthorizationFailed\"
```

tim: we rotated the mirror runner role yesterday during the org KMS key rotation. i suspect the new trust policy omitted ecr:PutImage permission for the target account role.

julie: product here — change window is 10:00-11:00 UTC for this release. they'd like to ship today. if we manual-approve the publish, do we lose provenance/attestation that Deploybot normally attaches? meaning auditability impact?

alex: quick summary: if we retag an already-pushed digest in the target account (i.e., create a tag pointing at the existing manifest/digest) we can avoid re-uploading layers, but the attestation record (cosign/certificate) may not exist for that account. Deploybot enforces an attestation check for any automatic promotion. fallback options:
- fix cross-account role and re-run mirror job (preferred)
- manually cosign the image in the target account and then call deploybot approve (manual attestation)
- force-deploy bypass (not recommended, breaks audit trace)

commands we might run (manual path):
```
# check layer availability in target account
aws ecr batch-check-layer-availability --repository-name release/6501 --layer-digests sha256:... --region eu-west-1 --profile target-account

# manual cosign sign (run from target-account session)
cosign sign --key ksm://projects/infra/keys/release-signer release-6501:sha256-xxxxxxxx

# then tell deploybot to recheck
deploybot approve --image release/6501 --env staging --meta manual-attestation:yes
```

maria: ops decision needed — product prefers within-window. if fix is <20m we wait, else we do manual attestation and note it in release notes.

oncall-bot: ALERT: mirror-runner sts credentials for role mirror-runner expired 57m ago; refresh required.

tim: confirmed — creds rotated but the role policy edit PR stalled. i'll push the missing ecr:PutImage permission now. opening PR -> https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1023 (adds target-account ecr:PutImage in assume-role policy). ETA ~15-25m including CI.

julie: product ok to wait up to 30m. if not green by end of window we fall back to manual attestation. please also include a short note in release notes about manual attestation if we need it.

alex: plan: tim merges -> we trigger mirror job requeue: `kubectl exec -n infra mirror-runner -- /bin/mirror --repo release/6501 --retry` then Deploybot will detect the attestation that mirror produces. if mirror doesn't re-run cleanly we run manual cosign as above and then `deploybot approve`.

maria: i'll draft a one-line release note update now: "Staging publish for 6501 delayed briefly due to cross-account mirror authz; resolved during window. Manual attestation used if mirror replay failed." will update after outcome.

tim: PR merged, creds refreshed, requeued mirror job (re-run id 2026-03-21-0915).

deploybot: publish-check RUNNING -> PASS for image release/6501. Attestation found: cosign://targets/eu-west-1/release/6501@sha256:abcdef123456. Promotion allowed.

maria: rolling canary now. product pinged for release note approval.

julie: release notes change looks good — approved. thanks all. :tada:

alex: postmortem todo: add a lint to the role-change checklist to ensure ecr:PutImage present for mirror roles, and add a deploybot flag `--allow-manual-attestation` that explicitly records manual attestation reason in audit logs.

maria: logging the incident and linking to PR and runbook. moving thread to #postmortems if needed. thanks everyone for quick turnaround. :white_check_mark:
